notes: Infrastructure. Homebrew runs on Linux (script) but on Linux the system package manager (pacman, apt, dnf) is the infrastructure analogue; on Windows the analogue is winget (Scoop and Chocolatey optional). No Windows build. pref-linux=linux_other pref-windows=- evidence https://docs.brew.sh/Homebrew-on-Linux

Infrastructure (Node.js plus npm). Current line shown to match the macOS brew node formula; LTS ids are winget OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS, scoop main/nodejs-lts, choco nodejs-lts.
